name: butecogames
description: Buteco Games Unleashed - A plataforma de jogos do Buteco dos Devs

scripts.docker:buildx:setup: docker buildx create --name multiplatform --driver docker-container --use 2>/dev/null || docker buildx use multiplatform
scripts.docker:build: docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile . && docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:push: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push . && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push:server: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:latest -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push:client: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:latest -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:build-staging: docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:staging -f packages/server/Dockerfile . && docker build -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:staging -f packages/client/Dockerfile .
scripts.docker:push-staging: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:staging -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push . && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:staging -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push-staging:server: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-server:staging -f packages/server/Dockerfile --push .
scripts.docker:push-staging:client: pnpm docker:buildx:setup && docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t brunofunnie/butecogames-client:staging -f packages/client/Dockerfile --push .
